report_name: New 'VOLTA' Infostealer Uses AI to Prioritize and Rank Stolen Data

attack_patterns.name: Credentials from Web Browsers
attack_patterns.description: VOLTA-AUTODOXER harvests passwords, cookies, and payment card details from Chromium-based browsers.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials In Files
attack_patterns.description: VOLTA-AUTODOXER harvests cryptocurrency wallet seed phrases from files on the compromised system.

attack_patterns.name: Steal Web Session Cookie
attack_patterns.description: VOLTA-AUTODOXER steals session tokens for Discord, Telegram, Steam, and Roblox.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Collected data is bundled and sent to the OpenRouter API, which serves as the exfiltration channel.

attack_patterns.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: VOLTA communicates with the LLM API gateway over standard HTTPS.

attack_patterns.name: AI Service API
attack_patterns.description: VOLTA uses the OpenRouter API gateway to send stolen data to various LLMs (Claude, Gemini, Kimi) for automated analysis and victim ranking, treating the AI service as a component of its C2 and analysis infrastructure.

malware.name: VOLTA-AUTODOXER
malware.description: A sophisticated Windows information-stealing malware that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) via the OpenRouter API to analyze, rank, and prioritize stolen data for financial monetization. It targets browser credentials, crypto wallets, and session tokens.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: A legitimate API gateway abused by VOLTA malware to query various Large Language Models for analyzing and ranking stolen data.

tools.name: Claude Opus 4.6
tools.description: An Anthropic Large Language Model used by the VOLTA malware via the OpenRouter API to analyze stolen data.

tools.name: Kimi K2
tools.description: A Moonshot AI Large Language Model used by the VOLTA malware as a fallback to analyze stolen data.

tools.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
tools.description: A Google Large Language Model used by the VOLTA malware as a fallback to analyze stolen data.

infrastructure.name: OpenRouter API Gateway
infrastructure.description: Used by VOLTA malware as an API gateway to query various LLMs for data analysis and serves as the exfiltration channel for stolen data.

indicators.name: VOLTA Infostealer C2/Exfil to OpenRouter
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: VOLTA Infostealer Network Connection to OpenRouter
id: 7c8d3e9f-a1b2-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects network connections to openrouter.ai, which is used by the VOLTA infostealer for C2 and data exfiltration. This may be noisy in environments with developers using this service.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/02/ai-powered-infostealer-volta-victim-profiling/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-03
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationHostname: 'openrouter.ai'
    Initiated: true
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of the OpenRouter API by developers or other tools.
level: medium
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to openrouter.ai, which is used by the VOLTA infostealer for data analysis and exfiltration.

indicators.name: VOLTA Infostealer LLM Prompt String
indicators.pattern:
title: VOLTA Infostealer LLM Prompt String
id: 8b9c4d0e-b2c3-4d6e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects the string "forensic intelligence analyst" used in the system prompt by VOLTA infostealer when communicating with LLM APIs.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/02/ai-powered-infostealer-volta-victim-profiling/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-03
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: 'forensic intelligence analyst'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Unlikely, but could be present in legitimate scripts or research tools.
level: high
indicators.description: Detects a specific string, "forensic intelligence analyst", from the VOLTA malware's LLM prompt, which may be visible in command line arguments or memory.
